title: Personal Loans History and PracticePay Late-Fee Relief
content:
**Rule.** The personal-loan share of a PracticePay Patient Financing late-fee relief reads every Larkspur personal loan the customer has held: a late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.8; a returned payment but no late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.9; otherwise the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

The entries read are the late-fee and returned-payment entries on all of the customer's Personal Loans, open or closed.

| On any of the customer's Personal Loans within the last 12 months | Personal-loan share |
|---|---|
| a late fee posted (with or without a returned payment) | 0.8 |
| a returned payment, no late fee | 0.9 |
| neither | 1 |

*Example (hypothetical, relief date 15 October).* A personal-loan payment returned on 2 February and no personal-loan late fee since 15 October of the year before: 0.9. A personal-loan late fee posted on 15 October of the year before is exactly 12 whole months back and outside the window.
